remarks: Move right into this very well-kept townhouse in the extremely desirable River's Edge Complex. Key features on this home include 2 bedrooms, primary bedroom walk in closet with custom shelving, 1.5 bathrooms, 2 brand new Nest thermostats, kitchen has stainless steel appliances, and a new replaced microwave hood. Townhouse location is close to the Springdale train station, scenic hiking trails, has ample parking, and amazing amenities. Complex has a pool house with a gym and a wonderful pool. Garage is located on the lowest level with an oversized laundry room and plenty of closets for storage. This townhouse is ready to be yours!
